# Zenderal magic — overview

Load-order-winning values for every magic record in the installed Zenderal modlist. Data lives in [`data/`](data/); per-record conflicts in [`magic-conflicts.md`](magic-conflicts.md).

## BEES dependency

**70 enabled plugins have HEDR 1.71** and load only because *Backported Extended ESL Support* is installed. Records whose winner is one of them carry `winnerNeedsBees: true`. Remove BEES and this dataset is wrong for all of them with no error anywhere.

Runtime corroboration: the BEES log reports **72** plugins emulated (log written 2026-10-13 20:12).

## Cost model

```
effectCost    = floor( mgef.BaseCost * max(magnitude,1)^1.1 * durFactor^1.1 )
durFactor     = 1 for Concentration effects (charged per second)
                else (duration==0 ? 10 : duration) / 10
spellAutoCost = Σ effectCost   // per-effect floor, then sum
```

Formula validated this run against base Enderal's own self-consistent spells (≥97% exact; the remainder are four known authored-drift records in base Enderal itself). `costDrift ≠ 0` on a non-`ManualCostCalc` spell means its stored cost no longer matches its live effect data — an override edited a shared MGEF or the spell's durations without a CK recompute. Those are rebalancing findings, filter `costDrift` in `data/spells.json`.

Runtime cost past `baseCost` is skill/perk-dependent; see `costModel` in [`data/lookups.json`](data/lookups.json) for the winning GMST curve (approximate — the 1/400 constant is engine-side).

## What a record dump cannot see

A lot of Enderal's magic balance lives in **Papyrus**, not records (e.g. `_00E_A1_ArcticWindME` carries `_00E_A1_ArcticWindSC` with a `PlayerLevel` property). Effects with attached scripts carry a `scripts[]` block in `magic-effects.json` — treat those as *flagged for manual reading* in `reference/base/EnderalScripts/source/scripts/`, not fully described here.
